content.text: {"results":[{"id":"univer-ai-native-office-sdk-spreadsheet-agent-headless-teardown","title":"Univer：面向 AI Agent 的嵌入式办公 SDK，2 万星，v1.0 本周发布","description":"dream-num/univer，Apache 2.0，TypeScript，~2 万星，DreamNum 团队出品。嵌入式办公 SDK，表格/文档/演示六种编辑器，可在 Node.js 无头运行。AI Agent 可通过 Facade API 按程序读写工作区，通过 Worktree 隔离编辑后等人类审批。v1.0.2 三天前发布，npm 月下载 190 万。核心红旗：xlsx 导入/导出是 Pro 付费功能，Worktree 协作也需要 Pro。","pubDate":"2026-09-27T00:00:00.000Z","tags":["办公套件","AI Agent","TypeScript","开源拆解","SDK","表格"],"category":"Tech-Experiment","url":"/blog/univer-ai-native-office-sdk-spreadsheet-agent-headless-teardown/"}]}
